title: Summit Club Lounge Waiver of the Crestline Companion Refund Processing Charge
content:
A holder of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes who holds an active membership in Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships has the refund processing charge on a companion taxes-and-fees refund reduced by a lounge waiver, which follows the holder's active Summit Club product:

| Holder's active Summit Club product | Lounge waiver of the refund processing charge |
|---|---|
| Summit Club Executive | 50 percent |
| Summit Club Lifetime | 50 percent |
| Summit Club Individual | 25 percent |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | 25 percent |
| no active membership, or any other club product | none |

Only a Summit Club membership whose status is active counts; a membership that is pending, in grace, lapsed or cancelled gives no waiver.

**Hypothetical case.** A holder with an active Summit Club Individual Plus membership has 25 percent of the refund processing charge waived; a holder whose Summit Club Executive membership has lapsed has none waived.
